CUSTOM PACKAGING FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Minimum quantities depend on the box format, dimensions, paper and finishing method. Tell us your expected quantity so the specification and order requirements can be reviewed together.

The schedule depends on sampling, material availability, finishing and quantity. Confirm the sample approval date, production window and shipping plan in the final quotation.

A physical sample helps confirm product fit, paper feel, opening behavior and print. Agree on sampling scope, cost and timing before proceeding.

Share your logo files, color references and preferred artwork. A physical proof or approved sample should be used as the final production reference.

Foil stamping, embossing, debossing, spot UV, soft-touch lamination and textured papers are possible directions. The appropriate process is confirmed for your chosen material and artwork.
